components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #18181b; color: #ffffff; padding: 6px 14px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 6px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #27272a; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

narrative.overview: ClauseLens is an ultra-minimalist, high-density desktop contract workbench engineered for legal counsel and commercial review. The aesthetic rejects decorative SaaS tropes—neon gradients, oversized floating cards, and gratuitous animations—in favor of an editorial, warm-monochrome workspace where document text is the supreme authority.
keyCharacteristics: High typographic discipline with high-contrast warm monochrome backgrounds.
Washed-out semantic spot pastels for ground evidence and diffs.
Ultra-flat component architecture with crisp 1px borders and zero heavy drop shadows.

rules.name: The Scarce Color Rule
rules.body: Color is never decorative; it appears only as a semantic indicator of legal evidence verification or contract difference.

rules.name: The Flat Elevation Rule
rules.body: Containers never float above the canvas on fuzzy blur shadows. Structure is defined exclusively by 1px borders and surface tone differences.

dos: Do maintain a strict 1px border rule across cards, headers, and modals.
Do preserve the warm monochrome palette (#FAFAF9 / #0D0D0E).
Do reserve spot pastels exclusively for verified quotes, warnings, and diff significance.
donts: Don't introduce heavy drop shadows (shadow-lg, shadow-xl).
Don't use primary-colored hero sections or saturated gradient backgrounds.
Don't use emojis in UI labels, tool status messages, or assistant copy.
